principle: Rhythmic collision through systematic desynchronization of temporal, spatial, and graphic registers that accelerate independently toward structural impossibility, producing intensification without spatial or temporal grounding.

nodes.label: Metric montage with variable unit length
nodes.description: Shot duration operates as rhythmic structure, systematically accelerating from 6.2-second average (exposition) to 1.4-second average (Steps climax) then decelerating to 3.1 seconds (finale), creating a measurable compression-expansion curve across runtime.
evidence: Average shot length measured across acts: 6.2s exposition, 2.8s mutiny, 1.4s Steps massacre, 3.1s finale.
Shot count per minute ranges from 12 (exposition) to 60+ (Steps climax).
Durational contrast within the Steps sequence reaches a 16:1 ratio between longest (8s mother shot) and shortest shots.
rules: Metric acceleration must remain desynchronized from temporal expansion so the two vectors move in opposite directions

nodes.label: Overlapping action temporal expansion
nodes.description: Single diegetic events fragment across multiple shots from different angles, extending screen duration 4.5 to 7 times beyond story time; a promised multi-perspectival completeness is delivered as spatial impossibility rather than spatial totality.
evidence: Pince-nez breaking: seven shots, 14 seconds of screen time representing about 2 seconds of story time, a 7:1 expansion.
Carriage descent: 42 shots, 90 seconds of screen time representing about 20 seconds of diegetic time, a 4.5:1 expansion.
rules: Temporal expansion must remain desynchronized from metric acceleration so moments lengthen while shots shorten

nodes.label: Tonal and graphic collision montage
nodes.description: Shots organize by visual opposition rather than spatial continuity: binary cuts between extreme grayscale values (80% to 20% luminance) in ABABAB patterns, and compositional diagonals that contradict across cuts (45-degree descending vs 30-degree ascending vectors forming X-patterns).
evidence: Officer confrontation alternates high-key and low-key extremes in an ABABAB pattern across 18 shots with no gradual transition.
Twelve instances in the Steps sequence where adjacent shot diagonals form an X-pattern when superimposed.

nodes.label: Serialized scalar close-up progression
nodes.description: Faces advance through fixed scale increments from long shot to extreme close-up, with each step halving the number of visible figures; spatial compression synchronizes with metric temporal compression to produce exponential intensification.
evidence: Mourning sequence progression: long shot crowd, medium shot of 5 figures, medium close-up of 3, close-up of one face, extreme close-up of eyes.
The identical scalar interval pattern repeats four times across the harbor sequence.
Tightest facial framings coincide with the 1.4-second shot average; return to medium and long shots coincides with the 3.1-second finale.
rules: As shot duration halves, facial framing must tighten proportionally to maintain information density per unit time

nodes.label: Vertical spatial stratification
nodes.description: The Steps sequence organizes bodies across six horizontal planes with strict hierarchical positioning: soldiers occupy the top plane only, crowd occupies planes 2-5, victims occupy ground level; only the carriage traverses the full vertical range.
evidence: Spatial segregation is maintained through 170+ shots until the final breach.
Soldiers appear exclusively in the top two bands; the crowd scatters across the lower four.
The carriage is the only element that descends through all six planes.
rules: Hierarchical plane boundaries must hold across 170+ shots so the carriage descent reads as transgression

nodes.label: Systematic 180-degree rule violation
nodes.description: Eyeline matches disregard screen direction: opposed parties look the same screen direction across cuts, producing spatial impossibility as a structural principle rather than continuity error; this illegibility masks the temporal manipulation of overlapping action.
evidence: Sailors look left at officers and officers look left at sailors, a spatially impossible pairing repeated 8 times in the mutiny sequence.
The pince-nez expansion depends on eyeline violations that make its space geometrically incoherent.
rule_violations: 180-degree rule and eyeline match conventions of continuity editing

nodes.label: Silent release (no structurally controlled sound)
nodes.description: The 1925 release carried no structurally controlled sonic dimension; the absence of auditory tempo cues forces all metric information into visual parameters, making shot duration the sole temporal organizing principle.
evidence: No sonic dimension was structurally controlled in the 1925 release despite later supervised scores.
The 16:1 durational contrast within the Steps sequence would be redundant if musical tempo were present.
The 8-second mother shot functions as a long note only because no actual long note exists.

nodes.label: Fabric as kinetic indicator (flags, sails, tarpaulin)
nodes.description: Flags, sails, tarpaulin, and clothing register wind and movement against static architecture; the fabric-to-rigid-surface ratio rises from 1:4 to 3:1 across the film, supplying motion cues that compensate for sonic absence and eventually exceed that compensatory role.
evidence: The flag occupies 15% of frame area across 22 shots, always in motion, against static stone and hull.
Fabric-to-rigid ratio shifts from 1:4 at the opening to 3:1 at the finale, tracking the metric acceleration.
Fabric presence increases in the final act even after metric acceleration makes it kinetically redundant, becoming an autonomous structural element.

nodes.label: Baby carriage descent
nodes.description: The carriage descends through all six spatial planes across 42 shots and 90 seconds of screen time; as the kinetic climax it occurs at a decelerated 2.8-second average shot length, slower than the surrounding 1.4-second material, inverting the compression-equals-intensification logic.
evidence: 42 shots, 90 seconds screen time, roughly 20 seconds diegetic time.
Only element to traverse the full vertical range of the six planes.
The fastest-moving object appears in the decelerated temporal zone at 2.8-second average shot length.
rules: Kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo rather than maximum metric velocity
rule_violations: The metric promise that compression equals intensification

nodes.label: Odessa Steps architectural grid
nodes.description: The steps function as a built-in compositional armature: horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel bands, with figures positioned at band intersections, supplying the physical grid on which vertical stratification is enforced.
evidence: Horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel bands.
Soldiers occupy the top two bands exclusively; the crowd scatters across the lower four.
Figures are positioned at band intersections across the sequence.

edges.rationale: Temporal expansion through overlapping action requires spatial incoherence (180-degree rule violations) to mask the temporal impossibility as multi-perspectival viewing; without directional violations the viewer perceives stuttering repetition rather than an extended moment.

Metric acceleration requires serialized scalar progression to maintain information density per unit time; as shot duration halves, facial framing must tighten proportionally through identical halving intervals.

Sonic absence forces metric information into visual parameters, making shot duration the sole temporal organizing principle and requiring 16:1 durational contrast ratios that would be redundant if musical tempo were present.

Graphic collision montage prevents visual synthesis across cuts, which enables metric acceleration to operate as a contradictory vector against temporal expansion without resolving into coherent space-time.

By blocking visual synthesis, collision montage lets temporal expansion coexist with metric acceleration as unresolved cross-purpose vectors; without it the registers could unify into coherent space-time.

Vertical spatial stratification must maintain hierarchical boundaries across 170+ shots to make the carriage's transgressive descent through all planes structurally legible as boundary violation rather than ordinary movement.

As metric velocity increases (shorter shots), fabric-to-rigid surface ratios must increase (1:4 to 3:1) to maintain kinetic information density through visual motion markers as temporal units compress.

Shots get shorter while moments get longer: metric montage says faster while overlapping action says slower, a productive desynchronization that cannot resolve into temporal coherence and is the core of the generative principle.

The six-plane hierarchy is built on the steps' physical armature: horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 bands, and the soldiers-top, crowd-middle, victims-bottom segregation is enforced on that grid.

The validation analysis classifies stratification as serving the collision montage rather than generating independent structural logic; its plane hierarchy organizes the Steps sequence visual oppositions.

The 42-shot, 4.5:1 carriage descent is the largest documented instance of overlapping action, intensifying the expansion mechanism at the sequence climax, though M2 also operates elsewhere (pince-nez).

The kinetic climax occurs at 2.8-second average shot length, slower than the surrounding 1.4-second material, inverting the metric promise that compression equals intensification precisely where that logic should culminate.

violated: Metric acceleration must remain desynchronized from temporal expansion so the two vectors move in opposite directions

failure_modes.consequence: If metric montage and overlapping action synchronize their acceleration and expansion rates, the temporal contradiction collapses into simple fast-cutting and the work becomes conventional continuity cinema; the collision-based generative principle fails.

If spatial continuity is maintained during overlapping action sequences, temporal expansion becomes legible as repetition error rather than multi-perspectival intensification; M2 loses its masking mechanism and reads as stuttering.

If graphic collision resolves into visual synthesis, the three measurement systems (metric, temporal, spatial) can unify into coherent space-time; M1 and M2 lose their structural antagonism and the desynchronization mechanism fails.

violated: Kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo rather than maximum metric velocity

failure_modes.consequence: If the carriage descent occurs at maximum metric velocity (1.4s average) instead of decelerated tempo (2.8s), the inversion of compression-equals-intensification logic breaks and the kinetic climax loses its structural distinction from the surrounding acceleration.

If fabric motion markers decrease during metric acceleration instead of increasing toward the 3:1 ratio, kinetic information density drops as temporal units compress and the visual rhythm of the metric system becomes illegible.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the work becomes spatially continuous narrative cinema rather than rhythmically organized collision; the entire temporal architecture collapses and no other mechanism can replace its
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, single-perspective continuity editing replaces multi-angle fragmentation; the expansion ratios that define intensification through temporal impossibility disappear and the work loses its
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, shots organize by spatial logic and continuity rather than visual collision; the lighting alternations and diagonal vector contradictions that create meaning through graphic opposition
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, metric acceleration loses its synchronized spatial compression; intensification could be replaced by other methods, but the exponential dual compression reinforcing the rhythmic structure disappears.
asserted_removal_tests.M5: If removed, the Steps sequence loses its visual hierarchy and the carriage descent loses its legibility as transgression through all planes; the collision montage it serves is weakened but survives.
asserted_removal_tests.M6: If removed, overlapping action's temporal impossibility becomes visible as repetition error; the enabling mask for the central expansion mechanism disappears, though M6 is not an autonomous structure.
